entries.bb6542305c17aaf5: A business that manufactures and sells paperboard, corrugated board, corrugated boxes and kraft pulp in Japan; it is the largest segment at Rengo Co., Ltd. Paperboard is made by the company, Marusan Seishi Co., Ltd. and others, and is sold through its own sales channels, including Rengo Paper Business Co., Ltd.; it is also supplied within the group as the main raw material for corrugated board. Corrugated board and corrugated boxes are handled independently by the company, Daiwa Shiki Co., Ltd., Setsu Carton Co., Ltd. and others, and the company and Rengo Riverwood Packaging Co., Ltd. also manufacture and sell multipacks used for six-can packs of canned beer and similar products. Kraft pulp is handled by Daiko Seishi Co., Ltd. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥521,869 million (previous year: ¥514,720 million; 101.4% year on year), the largest of the five categories. The company states that revenue increased, with a revision of product prices contributing. Production volumes were 2,481 thousand t for paperboard, 4,231 million m² for corrugated board and 3,597 million m² for corrugated boxes. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 9,066.
entries.bbac11ca42790d5f: In Japan, it makes containerboard, corrugated board, and corrugated boxes, and kraft pulp (the containerboard and paper processing-related business), flexible packaging products and cellophane (the flexible packaging-related business), and heavy-duty packaging products (the heavy-duty packaging-related business). Containerboard is made by the company, Marusan Paper Co., Ltd., and others, and is sold through its own sales channels and also supplied within the group as the main raw material for corrugated board. Overseas, it makes containerboard, corrugated board, corrugated boxes, flexible packaging products, heavy-duty packaging products, and nonwoven fabrics. Domestic production volume in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was containerboard 2,481 thousand t, corrugated board 4,231 million m2, and corrugated boxes 3,597 million m2, and overseas production volume was corrugated board 240 million m2 and corrugated boxes 225 million m2.
entries.c037a4c5071bac7f: As 'General Packaging Industry' = GPI Rengo, it aims to innovate all packaging needs of every industry. For the 5 years from the fiscal year ended March 2026 to the fiscal year ending March 2030, which is the 120th anniversary of its founding, it formulated the medium-term vision 'Vision120,' and states that with 'human-centeredness (human centrism)' and 'Less is more.' as the foundation of corporate management, it will work to improve the quality of its business scale. It positions the overseas business as a future growth field, states that it will strengthen deployment in China and Southeast Asia, and for India, Europe, North America and other regions, will mainly advance new deployment through the Tri-Wall Group.
entries.c04a5f65fb199b5b: Net sales in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1,008,337 million, 101.5% of the previous fiscal year (¥993,251 million). Net sales to external customers were ¥521,869 million for the containerboard and paper processing related business, ¥209,092 million for the overseas related business, ¥191,529 million for the flexible packaging related business, ¥46,419 million for the heavy-duty packaging related business, and ¥39,425 million for other businesses not included in the reportable segments. By product, corrugated boxes were the largest at ¥405,313 million, followed by flexible packaging products and cellophane at ¥214,134 million, containerboard at ¥62,956 million, corrugated board at ¥43,041 million, and other at ¥282,890 million. In response to changes in the cost structure such as rising logistics and labor costs and investment in environmental measures, it worked on price revisions for containerboard, corrugated board and paperboard products, and the containerboard and paper processing related business and the flexible packaging related business increased revenue through product price revisions. Net sales of the overseas related business were 98.1% of the previous fiscal year.
